question: Saturday and Sunday each have a 40% chance of rain. Treating them as independent, what is the chance of a dry weekend, in percent?
answer: A 36% chance of a dry weekend.
move: Every extra thing that must go right shrinks the odds of the whole.
ask: How many things must all go right for my plan this week to work?
trap: Each day is 60% dry, so the weekend seems 60% dry too.
hint: Find the chance each day stays dry, then the chance both do.
steps: A 36% chance of a dry weekend.
source: US National Weather Service, PoP guide
